Om rapporten redan publicerats.es: Me pregunto si el informe ya se ha publicado
Om rapporten redan publicerats.en: I wonder if the report has already been published.

texto: Control order, denial and adverbs in extensive subordinates. **Om rapporten redan publicerats** means «I wonder if the report has already been published.». Analyzes the scope and registration of the expression. Distinguish the data of the interpretation, check what evidence it holds and practice a precise paraphrase. Sequence 2 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
